bio: A failed actor assuming his dead twin’s identity to escape his embarrassing life circumstances. Jacob stumbles into a paranormal agency, where his struggle to do the right thing clashes with the lies keeping him alive.

otherWork.title: The Cellar Letters
otherWork.note: Creator and lead. Horror audio drama, 2020 onward.

about: Jamie is a New England based actor and writer with a lifelong love of horror. Before creating The Cellar Letters in 2020 and moving into podcasting, he worked toward a career in film and television: an experience that developed his character-driven approach to audio drama.

bio: Jacob’s closest friend and the team’s grounded tactician. Eli walks the line between loyal soldier and disillusioned leader, trying to protect his people while playing a dangerous game with the clandestine institutions giving the orders.
about: Johnathan “Athan” Magno is a content creator, producer, and creative director focused on scripted audio drama. His work centers on character-forward storytelling and high end sound design. Prior to production, he owned an escape room and spent five years in game design, shaping immersive experiences built around team-building and tension.

bio: The unit’s scholarly heart, who provides critical intelligence while field agents face supernatural dangers. When not in the archives or monitoring comms, she can be found with oversized headphones, listening to goth music while conducting research that might save lives.

otherWork.title: The Strange Case of Starship Iris
Greater Boston
otherWork.note: Lily of the Small Urban Community Garden.

about: Ishani Kanetkar stumbled into voice acting halfway through a PhD program - and several years and a doctorate later, has completely failed to wander back out again. Among other audio drama appearances, you can hear her award-winning work as Arkady on The Strange Case of Starship Iris, as well as Em on The Godshead Incidental, Mahira on VALENCE, Gwen on Second Star to the Left, and Leona on Starfall. In her free time, she can usually be found on the internet, encouraging people to draw fanart of her characters with swords.

bio: A former aberration hunter fleeing a corrupt legacy. Wielding violence like second nature, her sharp wit and sharper weapons make her indispensable. Despite her tough exterior, she's fiercely loyal to the team that has become her chosen family.

otherWork.title: Silent Hill Downpour in A Nutshell

about:
Kirsten Ria is a versatile British Actor known for their work in the gaming and horror community.

Kirsten's journey in media began after earning a Bachelor's Degree in Multimedia Production in 2010. Since then, she has worked across various creative roles. Including at What Culture and as a British voice for Watch Mojo.

Their voice acting credits include Mica Holloway in Hollowbody, Nora in The Bunny Graveyard 2 and Jo Valentine in the audio drama [Redacted] showcasing their ability to bring depth and emotion to horror driven narratives. She continues to expand her portfolio, lending her voice to exciting new projects in the gaming industry.

Kirsten is also a strong advocate for mental health awareness and LGBTQIA+ representation, using her platform to foster a supportive and inclusive community. She highlights the importance of mental well being and works to create spaces where people can feel seen and valued.

bio: The team’s self-taught technophile, Lucas hides deep insecurity behind nervous energy and eager helpfulness. Brilliant but riddled with self-doubt, he’s constantly trying to prove he belongs - even when he’s already holding the team together from behind the scenes.

otherWork.title: Dead West
otherWork.note: Voice actor, audio editor, and sound designer.

about:
Devin was born, raised, and marinated in the good old American West, where he works to tell stories in whatever medium is of interest to him this go-round; from television to podcasts and back again.

When he isn't sitting with spirits in ghost towns you can often find him at a local theater show or lifting heavy things in the gym. His favorite character of all time is Hellboy by Mike Mignola; because who doesn't like eldritch horrors and punching Nazis?

bio: A battle-worn veteran with more regrets than allies. Maxwell’s sardonic edge hides a deep grief and a fierce loyalty to the team. He knows how the game is played - and when it needs to be broken.

otherWork.title: Dr. Bob
otherWork.note: The voice of the SCP YouTube series.

otherWork.title: System Shock (2023)
otherWork.note: Frode Skara, Greg MacLeod, Kiner Perry. Video game.

about: My name may be Joe, but my voice is anything but average. Whether it's a gruff and gravelly mercenary or a falsetto cartoon platypus, you can hear my trademark sharp and clean vocal style cutting through. I'll bring the sound you're looking for. Let's go!

bio: The vibrant medical examiner who uses games and humor to balance her days of autopsies and dissections. The liveliest person in the room despite working exclusively with the dead, she finds whimsy in her macabre profession.
about: Ash Millman is a specialist in the horror genre, celebrating movies, games, and spooky media across the internet. If you're after a confident host and writer, an enthusiastic guest, versatile voice actor and voiceover artist, or an established social media content creator, then please get in touch at hello@ashmillman.co.uk.

bio: Sisters, speed demons, and the unit’s transport team. Nyx is blunt and brash, Evie smooth and professional; both adrenaline chasers with a fierce bond and no patience for rules they didn’t write.
about:
Hello! Nichole Goodnight here, from the lovely city of Rochester, New York. A little bit about me. As far as pets go, I have one hedgehog (Katamari), four cats (Egg, Toast, Oliver, and Persephone), and one fish that I’m pretty sure is immortal (Blueberry). in my spare time, I can usually be found speedrunning The Lion King on Twitch, playing games online, or reading!

I’ve always had a passion for voice acting, and have worked for small projects off and on through the years. I’ve done things from small commercials, to little animated shorts on YouTube. When I was young, my mom and I used to sing together. She’s really the first inspiration I had to use my voice for things other than speaking.

Maxwell’s old partner who vanished mid-mission. Respected and well-liked by the team, Silas was meticulous, intelligent, and strategic. His fate remains unknown, as does his connection to a deeper conspiracy.

about: Professional male voice over UK specialist with an award-winning RP accent. As a voiceover artist, I deliver commercial voiceovers, audiobooks, e-learning narration, and audio drama. Cambridge-trained astrophysicist. Studio-quality recordings delivered on time.

bio: The mysterious overseer of The [REDACTED] Unit who maintains strict operational standards from behind the scenes. To The [REDACTED] Unit, Control embodies the mysterious power structure they serve, deciding which cases get pursued and what resources will be allocated to the team's dangerous work.
about: I am an actor, voiceover artist, writer, TTRPG designer, and theatre-maker. I am currently working as a VEA at the Royal Exchange Theatre, as well as completing my own creative projects as a freelancer. I am interested in connecting with fellow creatives and production companies, and would love to be a part of bringing new, innovative stories to life!

bio: Eloise serves as a remote intelligence contractor who maintains communications through an old rotary phone. Working from an undisclosed location, she monitors police dispatches, emergency channels, and civilian reports to identify potential aberrant activity and provide cases to The [REDACTED] Unit.

otherWork.title: Doctor Who: The Queer Doctor Adventures

about:
Billie Lauren Hindle is an actress from Preston, Lancashire, UK.

She is a Co-Founder of and the Managing Director of Octavius Theatre Company Ltd (est. 2021).

She is best known for The Magnus Protocol (2024), Finding Emily (2026), Secrets of a Wallaby Boy (2023) and Partial Veil (2024).

She is also a writer, director and producer.

bio: The cleanup specialists who handle the aftermath of aberration neutralization. This enigmatic pair (Couple? Siblings? Both? Eww.) approach their work with zeal and mystery in equal measure.

about: Thomas Barker is an actor from New Zealand, working primarily in the medium of voiceover. Beginning his career on the stage, as well as studying classical music, he now performs in a variety of genres, from audio book narration, online and radio advertising, and character work for animation and video games.

Harlan Guthrie is a Canadian writer, editor, director, sound designer, musician, and voice actor. He is the sole creator and talent behind Malevolent, the Lovecraftian horror Audio Drama which is part of the Rusty Quill Network and runner up to the 2021 Discover Pods awards.

As a writer, a number of his works have been featured on the multi-award winning NoSleep Podcast and as an Audio Engineer he worked on Season 2 of The Town Whispers. His creation credits include the founding of the weekly streaming group The INVICTUS Stream as well as the Actual Play D&D podcast Dice Shame which he also edits and stars in. As a musician, he’s composed the main musical themes of Malevolent as well as wrote and recorded the musical motifs in Season 2 of Dice Shame.

Hi! My name is Zoe and I am a Taiwanese-American Voice Actor and Singer based in Texas. I've always had a passion for acting and bringing characters to life, but I started my VO journey in late 2022. When not in the booth, I can be found snuggling with my dog, terrorizing my friends with cricket noises, or just generally wreaking havoc and bringing chaos.

As a musician, I began playing violin at the age of 5. My grandparents brought home a tiny violin from Taiwan and I was hooked! I branched out into choir in 5th grade, managed to worm my way into All-State choir in High School, discovered a love for Musical Theatre, and a small hatred of music theory along the way. In the theater, I've worked with the likes of Steven Schwartz, Adam Pascal, and Steve Lutvak.

otherWork.title: The Grotto
otherWork.note: Lillian; also a writer on the show.

about: Natalie Light is a multi-nothing yet selling singer, voice actress, painter and sometimes-songwriter. She is known for her work in the fast-growing fictional audio drama The Grotto, which is notable for its heavy creative use of original and cover songs in storytelling, where she is one of the writers and also voices Lillan.

bio: Sloan is the Foundation’s PR specialist and resident “fixer,” expertly reshaping public perception whenever aberration activity leaks into the spotlight. Armed with sharp suits and a sharper smile, she crafts convincing narratives that neutralize panic, and turns near-catastrophes into harmless anomalies.

otherWork.title: Breathing Space: A Sci-Fi Western Audio Anthology

about:
Amidst a long list of random life encounters, Derek’s creative work has involved filmmaking on both sides of the camera, and eventually Escape Room design and management with Athan.

Outside of work, you can find Derek enjoying tabletop RPGs with friends, video gaming, reading books of all genres, and otherwise enjoying life with his wife and kids.

bio: A former data analyst who quit his corporate job after a close encounter with an aberration and the Foundation agents who failed to contain it. Mars now lives in a cluttered apartment filled with maps, string connections, and haphazard case files, where he operates a Youtube channel obsessing over aberration sightings that coincide with the cases of The [REDACTED] Unit.

bio: He’s always there. Same elevator, same time, always mid-conversation on his phone. No one knows his name, role, or department. Any attempt to engage him is quickly shut down with an annoyed, “I’m on the phone!”
